## Our technology commitment

[
[Close-up photo of a red tractor in a snow-covered field. Used to symbolize how Wolfspeed's
portfolio is strong and durable.]

### Designed to last, even in the harshest environments

We enable our customers to design longer-lasting systems to perform in tough operating environments
with products delivering ruggedness at every stage of product life cycle.

Learn more
][80]
[Three large solar panels set against a green field mid-ground and mountainous background. Image
used as an example of our energy storage technology.]

### Designed to comprehensively improve system efficiency

We empower our customers to more effectively create, convert and store energy with technology
providing higher ampacity while minimizing conduction and switching losses.

[Close up image of an electric car that is plugged in and charging. Used to illustrate how our
product line enables you to use high quality products without adding to product time.]

### Designed to reduce system cost and development time

We equip our customers to pivot to new system architectures to minimize their maintenance costs and
production time with clean switching and high-performance devices.

### About Wolfspeed

Wolfspeed continues to lead the industry transition from silicon to silicon carbide across both
materials and devices as the world’s only pure-play, vertically integrated silicon carbide company.
As the pioneers of silicon carbide, we are committed to powering a better world for everyone.

Who We Are
][81]

### Product Portfolio

Our solutions, including silicon carbide material, Power Modules, Discrete Power Devices and Power

consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.
[A construction worker wearing a safety vest and helmet ascends a spiral staircase, emphasizing

continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

A family of 15 across three generations runs a fully self-sufficient estate in South Netherlands,
growing around 70% of their own food, pumping water from 50 metres underground, and generating all
their own power from roughly 300 solar panels.

[How a cow schedule kept shutting down this printers]

At the end of a weak rural grid in County Offaly, a print and design studio lost power every time a
neighbouring farmer milked his cows.

A rare interview with Victron's founder Reinout Vader and his son, CTO Matthijs, has led to an
exceptional honour. Our 50 Years of Victron Energy film has won bronze at the annual Telly Awards,
competing against some of the biggest names in documentary filmmaking.

[Inside the Dutch Barn that must NEVER Lose Power]

### Inside the Dutch Barn that must NEVER Lose Power

This converted cow barn is quietly running a global payment app used by over a million people around
the clock.

A family of 15 across three generations runs a fully self-sufficient estate in South Netherlands,
growing around 70% of their own food, pumping water from 50 metres underground, and generating all
their own power from roughly 300 solar panels.

[How a cow schedule kept shutting down this printers]

### How a cow schedule kept shutting down this printers

At the end of a weak rural grid in County Offaly, a print and design studio lost power every time a
neighbouring farmer milked his cows.

competing against some of the biggest names in documentary filmmaking.

[Inside the Dutch Barn that must NEVER Lose Power]

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

When choosing electric car charging stations, consider the following factors:
* Intended location
* Desired charging speeds
* Number of ports you’ll need
* Maximum power output 
* Payment options 
* Safety certifications
* Equipment warranties, service, and support

[Considerations for installing EV charging stations at your location.][23]

What types of EV charging stations do you offer?

At Blink, we offer electric vehicle charging station products for commercial and residential use. We
offer Level 2 charging stations and DC fast chargers for commercial properties. [Why should you
consider a Level 2 charging station?][24]

Our products provide Level 2 and DC fast charging capabilities in various form factors like
pedestals, wall mounts, and mobile units.

Is any maintenance required for EV charging stations?

Yes, maintenance is required for electric cars’ charging stations to ensure proper and safe
operation and reduce downtime. [Ways of maintaining EV charge stations][25] include cleaning
connectors or ports to remove debris. It’s also best to inspect ports for loose connections and
faults and perform software updates to optimize performance. 

What support services do you offer?

Blink provides 24/7 customer support through multiple channels to address any questions. We also
install new equipment, perform maintenance and repair, and perform remote monitoring to maintain
functionality. 

Additional services include over-the-air software updates and training resources for customers and
partners. Blink aims to offer a reliable EV charging experience with around-the-clock assistance.

Blink offers [turnkey EV charging services][26], including installation, maintenance, and support,
to keep your charging stations running smoothly for longer.

## Ready to start designing your ideal EV Charging solution?

Learn how to use EV charging stations to attract new customers and increase duration and frequency
of visits at your business.

[Get in Touch][27]

# Experts in vehicle heating and power solutions

We are a Swedish manufacturer that specializes in vehicle heating and power solutions. Our products
serve the needs of both OEM and aftermarket customers in many industries worldwide. We have
solutions for 115V and 230V AC, and DC solutions from 12V up to 650V.

**You define your needs – We develop the solutions. **

## Our Products

For both traditional internal combustion engines and electric vehicles.

Our products for heating and power handling serve OEM and aftermarket customers in the automotive
industry.

[

## Thermal Management


Solutions for vehicle heating. Cab heaters, engine heaters, transmission heaters, axle heaters,
hydraulic oil heaters.

][32]
[

## Thermal Management – EV


Heating solutions for electric vehicles. Electric vehicles need heating of battery, cab and other
vital components and systems.

][33]
[

## Intelligent Power Handling


We have a wide range of products that solve your power handling needs. Chargers, voltage
converters and smart relays, to ensure optimal power handling.

][34]
[

## Cables


Calix offers a complete system of cables. Our system consist of connecting cables, inlet cables and
extension cables.

][35]
[

## Under development


Calix is always improving and developing new products. Read more about our new and exciting projects
here.

][36]
[Read more about our products][37]

## Research and Development

**From idea to finished product**.

Our skilled in-house engineers and technicians work closely with our customers in the automotive
industry to develop high quality products that suit their unique needs. The planning, drawing,
production, as well as testing, is done at our facilities in Eskilstuna, allowing for great
flexibility and innovation.  

[Smiling Calix employees looking at monitor]
[Read more about research and development][38]

## Vehicles

Calix products are available for a variety of vehicles.

Cars, buses, trucks, agricultural and construction machinery, as well industrial and special
applications. We adapt to the needs of the market.

[

## Cars


This is our home ground. We have solutions for most car makes and models. Read more about our
offering for cars. 

][39]
[

## Trucks and Buses


Calix provides heating solutions for trucks and buses. Traditional engine heating and cab heating,
but also heating for axles and transmissions. We also have solutions for EVs.

][40]
[

## Construction and Agriculture


We have solutions for construction and agriculture. Engine heating, cabin heating, axle heating, as
well as transmission heating and hydraulic oil heating. Read more about our solutions here. 

][41]
[

## Industrial and Special Applications


We offer products for special vehicles, such as ambulances, and for engines/gensets and marine
applications. Our EV solutions help heat up battery applications. 

][42]
[

## Find a solution for your vehicle


Our easy product search allows you to find the best solution for your vehicle.

][43]
[Read more about vehicle compatibility][44]

## About Calix

A long history of quality Swedish engineering.

We believe in sustainable, high quality products made by skilled workers.

[

## History


Calix is the result of innovative thinking and hard work. For more than 20 years, Calix has been one
of the largest European manufacturers of electrical engine heater systems and it all started in
Eskilstuna, Sweden.

][45]
[

## Quality


Quality is at the heart of all we do. All Calix products are tested in our SEMKO-certified
laboratory, where we simulate the most extreme conditions a car may be subjected to.

][46]
[

## Environment


Environmental care is very important to us at Calix. As a Tier 1 supplier we need to excel in
sustainability to deliver what our customers expect of us.

][47]
[Read more about Calix][48]

## We are Intertek certified

To ensure our products maintain the highest quality possible.

All Calix products are tried, tested and certified by Intertek, an independent testing institute and
certification body.

[SEMKO Intertek logo]
[Read more about our certificates][49]
[Calix AB Logotype]

## CALIX AB

**Visiting address:**
Filargatan 14
632 29 Eskilstuna

**Phone:**
+46 16-10 80 00

Or contact us by [email][50]

**

# Experts in vehicle heating and power solutions

We are a Swedish manufacturer that specializes in vehicle heating and power solutions. Our products
serve the needs of both OEM and aftermarket customers in many industries worldwide. We have
solutions for 115V and 230V AC, and DC solutions from 12V up to 650V.

**You define your needs – We develop the solutions. **

## Our Products

For both traditional internal combustion engines and electric vehicles.

Our products for heating and power handling serve OEM and aftermarket customers in the automotive
industry.

[

## Thermal Management


Solutions for vehicle heating. Cab heaters, engine heaters, transmission heaters, axle heaters,
hydraulic oil heaters.

][32]
[

## Thermal Management – EV


Heating solutions for electric vehicles. Electric vehicles need heating of battery, cab and other
vital components and systems.

][33]
[

## Intelligent Power Handling


We have a wide range of products that solve your power handling needs. Chargers, voltage
converters and smart relays, to ensure optimal power handling.

][34]
[

## Cables


Calix offers a complete system of cables. Our system consist of connecting cables, inlet cables and
extension cables.

][35]
[

## Under development


Calix is always improving and developing new products. Read more about our new and exciting projects
here.

][36]
[Read more about our products][37]

## Research and Development

**From idea to finished product**.

Our skilled in-house engineers and technicians work closely with our customers in the automotive
industry to develop high quality products that suit their unique needs. The planning, drawing,
production, as well as testing, is done at our facilities in Eskilstuna, allowing for great
flexibility and innovation.  

[Smiling Calix employees looking at monitor]
[Read more about research and development][38]

## Vehicles

Calix products are available for a variety of vehicles.

Cars, buses, trucks, agricultural and construction machinery, as well industrial and special
applications. We adapt to the needs of the market.

[

## Cars


This is our home ground. We have solutions for most car makes and models. Read more about our
offering for cars. 

][39]
[

## Trucks and Buses


Calix provides heating solutions for trucks and buses. Traditional engine heating and cab heating,
but also heating for axles and transmissions. We also have solutions for EVs.

][40]
[

## Construction and Agriculture


We have solutions for construction and agriculture. Engine heating, cabin heating, axle heating, as
well as transmission heating and hydraulic oil heating. Read more about our solutions here. 

][41]
[

## Industrial and Special Applications


We offer products for special vehicles, such as ambulances, and for engines/gensets and marine
applications. Our EV solutions help heat up battery applications. 

][42]
[

## Find a solution for your vehicle


Our easy product search allows you to find the best solution for your vehicle.

][43]
[Read more about vehicle compatibility][44]

## About Calix

A long history of quality Swedish engineering.

We believe in sustainable, high quality products made by skilled workers.

[

## History


Calix is the result of innovative thinking and hard work. For more than 20 years, Calix has been one
of the largest European manufacturers of electrical engine heater systems and it all started in
Eskilstuna, Sweden.

][45]
[

## Quality


Quality is at the heart of all we do. All Calix products are tested in our SEMKO-certified
laboratory, where we simulate the most extreme conditions a car may be subjected to.

][46]
[

## Environment


Environmental care is very important to us at Calix. As a Tier 1 supplier we need to excel in
sustainability to deliver what our customers expect of us.

][47]
[Read more about Calix][48]

## We are Intertek certified

To ensure our products maintain the highest quality possible.

All Calix products are tried, tested and certified by Intertek, an independent testing institute and
certification body.

[SEMKO Intertek logo]
[Read more about our certificates][49]
[Calix AB Logotype]

## CALIX AB

**Visiting address:**
Filargatan 14
632 29 Eskilstuna

**Phone:**
+46 16-10 80 00

Or contact us by [email][50]

**

# Your all-in-one partner in EV charging

## Deploy a charging solution that fits your organizational goals.

* *What we do

We simplify your transition to electric. With more charging ports deployed than anyone in the
industry, we bring unmatched expertise and a complete portfolio of reliable hardware, intelligent
software and dependable services, delivering an EV charging solution tailored for your organization.

* *How we work with you

We are not station operators; we are charging solution enablers. Whether you’re an organization
looking to attract drivers to your place of business, a fleet focused on operating at maximum
efficiency or want to operate an EV charging business of your own, ChargePoint can help you deliver
a world- class EV charging program.

[Connect With an Expert][108]
[Person using the ChargePoint CMS]

## Innovation at our core

We engineer the most advanced EVSE technology from the ground up, giving you fully integrated
systems optimized for performance and value.
* Our stations are designed in-house with modular, easy-to-repair architecture, and innovations like
  ChargePoint® Omni Port and cut-resistant cables to deliver an unparalleled ownership experience.
* Built for any scale, the ChargePoint Platform gives you complete control and rich insights with
  our unified EV charge management system, while operating the hardware of your choice.
* Pairing our stations with ChargePoint software delivers functionality well beyond OCPP compliance
  with features like Waitlist, AI automation, and Fleet Operations.
* In partnership with Eaton, we’re extending our innovation behind the meter and co-developing
  technology that will define our industry into the future.

“It’s amazing to be able to log in, put in the metrics I want to pull and see live data on our
portfolio of stations.”

Laurie LeLack

Global Director, Corporate Real Estate

[Citrix Logo]
[Bus charging on ChargePoint Express 280]

## End-to-end reliability

Trust underpins customer success, and we deliver the confidence you need to scale as your business
grows.
* Keep stations performing and vehicles on the road with tailored support packages backed by
  experts.
* Let us take care of the driver experience with our complimentary 24/7 driver support.
* Rely on expert guidance for everything from initial site walks and first-time-right installations
  to long-term program optimization.

“It’s true bliss to log into a dashboard, see all the different sites with the chargers at a glance,
and know whether we need to scale further.”

Christian Boerger

Vice President of Revenue Strategy

[Oxford Collection Logo]
[Person tapping on ChargePoint CP6000]

## World-class driver experience

Connect with EV drivers when they want to charge.
* Reach our 4 million+ EV drivers and draw them to your stations via our mobile app and in-dash
  integrations.
* Serve more drivers with innovative solutions that ensure everyone can get a charge.
* Leverage the tools you need to build a world-class experience that keeps drivers coming back.

# Your all-in-one partner in EV charging

## Deploy a charging solution that fits your organizational goals.

* *What we do

We simplify your transition to electric. With more charging ports deployed than anyone in the
industry, we bring unmatched expertise and a complete portfolio of reliable hardware, intelligent
software and dependable services, delivering an EV charging solution tailored for your organization.

* *How we work with you

We are not station operators; we are charging solution enablers. Whether you’re an organization
looking to attract drivers to your place of business, a fleet focused on operating at maximum
efficiency or want to operate an EV charging business of your own, ChargePoint can help you deliver
a world- class EV charging program.

[Connect With an Expert][108]
[Person using the ChargePoint CMS]

## Innovation at our core

We engineer the most advanced EVSE technology from the ground up, giving you fully integrated
systems optimized for performance and value.
* Our stations are designed in-house with modular, easy-to-repair architecture, and innovations like
  ChargePoint® Omni Port and cut-resistant cables to deliver an unparalleled ownership experience.
* Built for any scale, the ChargePoint Platform gives you complete control and rich insights with
  our unified EV charge management system, while operating the hardware of your choice.
* Pairing our stations with ChargePoint software delivers functionality well beyond OCPP compliance
  with features like Waitlist, AI automation, and Fleet Operations.
* In partnership with Eaton, we’re extending our innovation behind the meter and co-developing
  technology that will define our industry into the future.

portfolio of stations.”

Laurie LeLack

Global Director, Corporate Real Estate

## End-to-end reliability

Trust underpins customer success, and we deliver the confidence you need to scale as your business
grows.
* Keep stations performing and vehicles on the road with tailored support packages backed by
  experts.
* Let us take care of the driver experience with our complimentary 24/7 driver support.
* Rely on expert guidance for everything from initial site walks and first-time-right installations
  to long-term program optimization.

and know whether we need to scale further.”

Christian Boerger

* Serve more drivers with innovative solutions that ensure everyone can get a charge.

# Find Fast EV Chargers Near You

Download the EVgo App on iOS and Android

[[Apple App Store logo] ][9][[Get it on Google Play] ][10]
[EVgo Network Map]

### Public Fast Charging for All

As one of the largest and most advanced EV fast charging networks nationwide, EVgo powers the
freedom of movement with robust charging for all EV models. With over 1,200 public fast charging
stations and multiple pricing plans, EVgo delivers speed, ease and convenience for EV drivers across
the country. Today, more than 40% of the U.S. population lives within 10 miles of an EVgo fast
charger, so it’s never been easier to power up with EVgo wherever you live, shop, work or travel.  

[Find a Charger Find a charger ][11]

## EVgo for Everyone

EVgo chargers are compatible with all fast-charge capable EVs. We are here for EV drivers, business
owners, automakers, autonomous vehicle companies, rideshare drivers, and the list goes on!  

[Fast Charging Station in Fairfield, Ohio]

Business & Commercial

Attract customers by hosting fast charging stations on your property.

[Learn More ][12]
[Fast Charging Station in Murrieta, CA]

Automaker Partners

Partner with EVgo to design a charging solution that works for your organization.

[Learn More ][13]
[Man and child charging Nissan Leaf at EVgo station]

Drivers

Charge with confidence at our 1,200+ stations across the U.S.

[Learn More ][14]

## How to Charge

[Learn More Learn more about how to charge your EV ][15]

### EVgo’s Deep Industry Experience

[Industry leading experience]

With 15 years of experience owning and operating one of the nation's largest public fast charging
networks, EVgo is a first mover and industry leader in infrastructure deployment. We work with
automakers, site hosts, businesses, rideshare operators, autonomous vehicle companies, utilities,
and other stakeholders to accelerate nationwide expansion of fast charging infrastructure, making it
easier and more convenient for EV drivers to charge when and where they like and need. 

[Learn More Learn more about EVgo's industry experience ][16]
[Industry leading experience]
[EVgo Mobile App Screens]

### Discover Chargers On-the-Go
* View real-time charger availability
* Monitor your charging session
* View session summary
* Charge seamlessly with Autocharge+

[[Download on the App Store] ][17][[Get it on Google Play] ][18]
backnext
[EVgo customer smiling while charging her vehicle]

"I choose EVgo for fast charging because it’s a no brainer. I can use my app, or Google ‘EV
charging’ to find a close location and off I go."

-Shante

Los Angeles, CA

Watch VideoWatch Shante's testimonial
[EVgo customer smiling while charging her car]

"Our family has peace of mind using EVgo because no matter where we drive, there are always enough
charging stations to enjoy our rides."

-Denise

Hawthorne, CA

Watch VideoWatch Denise's testimonial
[EVgo customer Nestor smiling]

"EVgo fast charging is a game changer. With my commute, those white boxes are more than just
chargers, they are peace of mind."

-Nestor

Los Angeles, CA

Watch VideoWatch Nestor's testimonial

## EVgo in the News

[View All News ][19]
[Read article "Uber Will Offer Incentives for E.V. Charger Construction" ][20]
[Uber Will Offer Incentives for E.V. Charger Construction]
Feb 18, 2026 news

### Uber Will Offer Incentives for E.V. Charger Construction

The company said it would encourage companies that operated chargers to install them in
neighborhoods where its drivers lived and work.

Read More
[Read article "US EV Drivers Have a Wealth of Fast Charger Options" ][21]
[US EV Drivers Have a Wealth of Fast Charger Options]
Jan 29, 2026 news

### US EV Drivers Have a Wealth of Fast Charger Options

The time it takes to fuel an electric vehicle, long a stumbling block to EV adoption, is shrinking
in the US, as more capable cars and trucks plug into a rash of new, high-speed charging machines.

Read More
[Read article "EVgo bets on NACS as Tesla’s charging port takes over US EVs" ][22]
[EVgo bets on NACS as Tesla’s charging port takes over US EVs]
Jan 27, 2026 news

### EVgo bets on NACS as Tesla’s charging port takes over US EVs

EVgo is betting big on Tesla’s charging standard. After a 2025 pilot that put nearly 100 NACS
connectors online across 22 major metro areas, the public fast-charging provider says it plans to
scale quickly, with more than 500 NACS connectors expected to be installed by the end of this year
at both existing sites and new locations.

Read More

# Inverter Service

# Inverter Service specializes in the repair of electronic equipment.

We are European market leaders in the repair and refurbishment of inverters for PV systems, charging
infrastructure for electric vehicles (EV), and battery systems for renewable energy storage.
Other applications, such as frequency converters and motor drives for industrial motors and EVs, are
also part of our portfolio.
Thanks to our expertise, we extend the service life of critical energy installations and help
customers optimize the reliability and efficiency of their systems in a sustainable way.

## Depending on needs and customer type, we offer a range of different services.

Manufacturer
* Administrative support
* Technical support
* After-sales service
* Warranty repairs and replacements

Installers / O&M
* Technical support
* Repair
* Warranty handling
* Training

Endusers

## What are the advantages of repairing your device?

#### LIMITING WASTE

Up to 70% less electronic waste!

#### COST-SAVING

A repair is cheaper than a new device, up to 85%!

#### TIME-SAVING

Our service guarantees fast and perfect repair!

**At Inverter Service, we repair all brands and all types.**
We have been active in this field for more than 10 years and have therefore built up extensive
knowledge and experience. Each year, we repair more than 10,000 devices, achieving a success rate of
over 90%!

Several studies have shown that repairing inverters is significantly more cost-effective than
replacement or repowering.
In addition, it offers numerous advantages in terms of system configuration, communication, and
compatibility with other equipment.
Last but not least, the impact on the climate also makes a substantial difference.

Thanks to these efforts, we manage to avoid nearly **500 tons of waste every year**. And you play a
key role in this—by choosing to repair devices instead of replacing them with new ones.

In addition, for several manufacturers, we also act as a **service partner or repair center**.

Thanks to these partnerships, we are able to provide comprehensive service and support, both in and
out of warranty.

Our partners are :

## Is your device defective? That's how it works:

#### 1 SEND

You or a transporter brings the device to us.

#### 2 RESEARCH

We do extensive research on your device.

#### 3 DIAGNOSIS.

We will diagnose your device and provide you with a cost for repair.

#### 4 DECISION

You decide to have the repair performed or not.

#### 5 REPAIR

We repair your device and perform the necessary tests.

#### 6 RETURN

The inverter can be retrieved.

# Our assets

Already more than 20 years of experience in electronics repair and 15 years in the photo-voltaic
sector.

We repair according to the rules of art and afterwards we do extensive tests.

Young and dynamic team.

# Our KPI’s

Repair more than 90% of the devices.

Repair within 7 days after receipt.

Correct error diagnosis and pricing within 48h.

# Inverter Service

# Inverter Service specializes in the repair of electronic equipment.

We are European market leaders in the repair and refurbishment of inverters for PV systems, charging
infrastructure for electric vehicles (EV), and battery systems for renewable energy storage.
Other applications, such as frequency converters and motor drives for industrial motors and EVs, are
also part of our portfolio.
Thanks to our expertise, we extend the service life of critical energy installations and help
customers optimize the reliability and efficiency of their systems in a sustainable way.

## Depending on needs and customer type, we offer a range of different services.

Manufacturer
* Administrative support
* Technical support
* After-sales service
* Warranty repairs and replacements

Installers / O&M
* Technical support
* Repair
* Warranty handling
* Training

Endusers

* Training

## What are the advantages of repairing your device?

#### LIMITING WASTE

Up to 70% less electronic waste!

#### COST-SAVING

A repair is cheaper than a new device, up to 85%!

#### TIME-SAVING

Our service guarantees fast and perfect repair!

[

#### DIEHL

Bonfiglioli, Imeon Energy, …

][28]
[

#### KOSTAL

Nedap, Samil Power, …

][29]

**At Inverter Service, we repair all brands and all types.**
We have been active in this field for more than 10 years and have therefore built up extensive
knowledge and experience. Each year, we repair more than 10,000 devices, achieving a success rate of
over 90%!

Several studies have shown that repairing inverters is significantly more cost-effective than
replacement or repowering.
In addition, it offers numerous advantages in terms of system configuration, communication, and
compatibility with other equipment.
Last but not least, the impact on the climate also makes a substantial difference.

Thanks to these efforts, we manage to avoid nearly **500 tons of waste every year**. And you play a
key role in this—by choosing to repair devices instead of replacing them with new ones.

In addition, for several manufacturers, we also act as a **service partner or repair center**.

Thanks to these partnerships, we are able to provide comprehensive service and support, both in and
out of warranty.

Our partners are :

## Is your device defective? That's how it works:

#### 1 SEND

You or a transporter brings the device to us.

#### 2 RESEARCH

We do extensive research on your device.

#### 3 DIAGNOSIS.

We will diagnose your device and provide you with a cost for repair.

#### 4 DECISION

You decide to have the repair performed or not.

#### 5 REPAIR

We repair your device and perform the necessary tests.

#### 6 RETURN

The inverter can be retrieved.

# Our assets

Already more than 20 years of experience in electronics repair and 15 years in the photo-voltaic
sector.

We repair according to the rules of art and afterwards we do extensive tests.

Young and dynamic team.

# Our KPI’s

Repair more than 90% of the devices.

Repair within 7 days after receipt.

Correct error diagnosis and pricing within 48h.

Message from

## Our Chairman

India and all the other nations are putting in their best efforts to cut down on their carbon
emissions and the transportation sector is a major goal-setter for this.

The PLI scheme for the Auto sector and the Scrappage policy is a major push towards electrification.
We need to ensure that we deliver robust products that suit the diverse and extreme requirements of
the Indian conditions.

We have successfully developed many products in-house as well as partnered with global companies to
ensure a faster time to market and I would gladly say that we have a first-mover advantage in
providing all solutions under one roof. Speed is of the essence to ensure that all our efforts bear
fruits.

Be it Power Electronics, Light Weighting technologies, Transmission, and Electric powertrains for
Commercial Vehicles, we are a one-stop solutions provider for all the electrification needs of our
customers. But we do not stop here, we need to have an innovation mindset whereby we keep on
becoming better through passionate engineering.

Let us all stay motivated and true to the cause for which we all started on this journey towards
making our planet and India greener and cleaner.

Read more

**Mr. Baba N. Kalyani**
Chairman & MD, Bharat Forge Ltd. (Parent Company of Kalyani Powertrain Ltd.)

Message from

## Our Vice-Chairman

Dear Patrons,

Kalyani Powertrain Ltd. is an integral addition to our Bharat Forge family. It carries the DNA of
innovation within each of its offerings.

Our vision is to create future-forward mobility solutions focused on the needs of both domestic and
international customers. The key will be to combine sustainability with economic viability through
innovative technology to drive mobility transformation.

We have been extensively researching and working to establish a strong fundamental base to learn and
develop new concepts and expertise in e-mobility technologies to unleash a dazzling array of
innovations. Our current portfolio includes a bouquet of solutions for the electrification of
Commercial Vehicles.

These range from providing selected sub-systems to complete electric powertrain kits, keeping
technology, durability, and performance as the differentiator and key evaluation criteria.

We are here, to be a part of the carbon-free transportation revolution and are committed to
accelerate the transition towards a sustainable future.

Join us in our journey to innovate and create the mobility solutions for a greener tomorrow.

Read more

**Mr. Amit Kalyani**
Vice-Chairman & Joint Managing Director, Bharat Forge Ltd. (Parent Company of Kalyani Powertrain
Ltd.)

Our solid-state electronics for the control and conversion of electric power for your Electric
Vehicles are fitted with the best-in-class switching devices such as diodes, thyristors, and power
transistors.

Kalyani Powertrain's Ltd. offering under this segment provide the following benefits:

High Power
Density

Reliability

Kalyani Powertrain Ltd. provides a one stop solution for the development of a complete Electric
Vehicle powertrain based on the modular configurations of customers and providing power outputs
covering wide range depending upon the end use-case.

When it comes to making the switch to clean transportation you need the best solution, without
compromise. A Kalyani Powertrain Ltd. Re-powered Electric Truck or Bus delivers on its commercial,

Delivering on Environmental Promise

Getting the Job done Everyday and Reliably

Delivering Operational Cost Benefits

Guaranteeing Highest Up-time

## Featured Programs and Rebates

Program

### Level Pay

Monthly billing is here! Level Pay is a new, convenient monthly bill payment option that helps you
budget for your LADWP bill and pay off past due amounts.

[ Learn more ][71]
Program

### Landscape Efficiency Assistance Program

Free services for lawn removal and replacement with California Friendly® landscaping.

[ Learn more ][72]
Program

### EZ Save

The EZ-SAVE Program helps income-qualified customers save on their LADWP bills.

[ Learn more ][73]
Program

### Solar Programs

A key element of LADWP’s renewable energy program is the development of local solar, particularly
customer based programs that tap into the city’s abundant sunshine and provide residents and
businesses with the ability to generate their own power.

[ Learn more ][74]
Program

### Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP)

Helps eligible income-qualified households to manage and meet their immediate home heating and/or
cooling needs.

[ Learn more ][75]
Program

### Senior Citizen / Disability Lifeline Rate

The Lifeline Rate Program is a City of LA Office of Finance program that offers senior and disabled
citizens an exemption on their electric and other utility bills. This rate is available under
provisions of the Los Angeles Municipal Code or the Revenue and Taxation Code of the State of
California.

[ Learn more ][76]
Program

### Cool LA

Cool LA is designed to help LADWP customers better manage the impacts of extreme heat caused by
climate change, especially older adults, income-qualified families, and those living in underserved
communities where hot weather has an especially significant impact.

[ Learn more ][77]
Program

### Water Insights

LADWP’s My Water Insights is a free home water management program designed to help customers better
understand their water use through home water reports and a user-friendly online portal.

[ Learn more ][78]

Programs and resources designed to support your business needs.

### LADWP's Summer of Soccer

Stay cool and connected this summer. From powering the games to hydrating fans, learn how LADWP is
keeping the City of Los Angeles ready for every World Cup moment.

[ Learn more ][83]

## Featured Programs and Rebates

Program

### Level Pay

Monthly billing is here! Level Pay is a new, convenient monthly bill payment option that helps you
budget for your LADWP bill and pay off past due amounts.

[ Learn more ][71]
Program

### Landscape Efficiency Assistance Program

Free services for lawn removal and replacement with California Friendly® landscaping.

[ Learn more ][72]
Program

### EZ Save

The EZ-SAVE Program helps income-qualified customers save on their LADWP bills.

[ Learn more ][73]
Program

### Solar Programs

A key element of LADWP’s renewable energy program is the development of local solar, particularly
customer based programs that tap into the city’s abundant sunshine and provide residents and
businesses with the ability to generate their own power.

[ Learn more ][74]
Program

### Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP)

Helps eligible income-qualified households to manage and meet their immediate home heating and/or
cooling needs.

[ Learn more ][75]
Program

### Senior Citizen / Disability Lifeline Rate

The Lifeline Rate Program is a City of LA Office of Finance program that offers senior and disabled
citizens an exemption on their electric and other utility bills. This rate is available under
provisions of the Los Angeles Municipal Code or the Revenue and Taxation Code of the State of
California.

[ Learn more ][76]
Program

### Cool LA

Cool LA is designed to help LADWP customers better manage the impacts of extreme heat caused by
climate change, especially older adults, income-qualified families, and those living in underserved
communities where hot weather has an especially significant impact.

[ Learn more ][77]
Program

### Water Insights

LADWP’s My Water Insights is a free home water management program designed to help customers better
understand their water use through home water reports and a user-friendly online portal.

[ Learn more ][78]

## THE LONDON EV COMPANY

### LEVC: A Legacy of Innovation and Sustainable Mobility Solutions

Since 1908, LEVC (London EV Company) has been at the forefront of British automotive craftsmanship
and innovation. Renowned for designing the first dedicated black cab for London, our brand has
become a symbol of quality, reliability, and timeless design.

In 2018, we revolutionized urban mobility with the launch of the electric TX—the world's cleanest
and most advanced taxi with groundbreaking eCity, REEV (Range-Extended Electric Vehicle) technology.
This pioneering model reflects our unwavering commitment to innovation and sustainability, helping
cities around the globe transition to greener transport solutions.

As we continue to build on our iconic heritage, LEVC is transforming into a high-volume,
all-electric automotive leader. With a forward-thinking strategy, we are dedicated to creating
smarter, cleaner, safer, and more accessible mobility solutions designed for modern living.

Our mission is to redefine the future of urban transportation—driving progress while reducing
environmental impact. Join us in setting new standards in efficiency, innovation, and excellence.

## THE LONDON EV COMPANY

### LEVC: A Legacy of Innovation and Sustainable Mobility Solutions

Since 1908, LEVC (London EV Company) has been at the forefront of British automotive craftsmanship
and innovation. Renowned for designing the first dedicated black cab for London, our brand has
become a symbol of quality, reliability, and timeless design.

In 2018, we revolutionized urban mobility with the launch of the electric TX—the world's cleanest
and most advanced taxi with groundbreaking eCity, REEV (Range-Extended Electric Vehicle) technology.
This pioneering model reflects our unwavering commitment to innovation and sustainability, helping
cities around the globe transition to greener transport solutions.

As we continue to build on our iconic heritage, LEVC is transforming into a high-volume,
all-electric automotive leader. With a forward-thinking strategy, we are dedicated to creating
smarter, cleaner, safer, and more accessible mobility solutions designed for modern living.

Our mission is to redefine the future of urban transportation—driving progress while reducing
environmental impact. Join us in setting new standards in efficiency, innovation, and excellence.

[ [Janta Power Brings Rapidly Deployable Clean Energy to Fan Festivals and Beyond] ][53]
Jul 24, 2026 [

#### Janta Power Brings Rapidly Deployable Clean Energy to Fan Festivals and Beyond

][54]

**Janta Power**, a leading developer of patented three-dimensional solar tower energy systems,
announced a milestone for rapidly deployable infrastructure in support of one of the world’s largest
sporting events. At Fan Festival sites in Dallas and Houston, Janta’s innovative solar towers
generated power quietly and concurrently, demonstrating a new model for energy installations that
simplify sourcing logistics and align with compressed operational timelines.

[solar]The Dallas installation at Fair Park consists of four JP5K solar towers with integrated 28
kWh battery energy storage systems (BESS) and served as a temporary power source for the duration of
the Fan Festival. The East Downtown Houston tower and associated BESS served the Fan Festival and
will remain as a permanent fixture, purchased to benefit the community and provide power for public
amenities over a 25-year life span.

Both tower systems were deployed and fully operational within days, generating up to 275 KWh per day
to support event infrastructure for thousands of visitors throughout the Fan Festivals. In addition,
the towers feature a small footprint and visually appealing, fully functional body panels with
graphic designs representing the energetic spirit of the host cities.

"The World Cup is more than a sporting event – it's a proving ground for the future of energy
infrastructure," said Mohammed Njie, Founder and CEO of Janta Power. "By providing clean, quiet
power in days instead of months, we're demonstrating that renewable energy can be delivered where
it's needed most, without sacrificing speed, reliability, or performance. Whether it's powering a
global event, an AI data center, an airport, or a community, our mission is the same: to make clean,
affordable, and reliable energy quickly available wherever people need it.”

“Reliable power is a constant logistical consideration across festivals and large-scale events, so
solutions that simplify deployment can have a real operational impact,” said Skye Fabrizio,
Sustainability Manager at C3 Presents. “Janta’s towers were installed quickly, required minimal
space compared to standard solar installations, and provided quiet, reliable power directly on-site.
After seeing the technology in action, I see meaningful potential for its use across a much wider
range of live events and temporary installations."

Janta’s vertical solar towers are designed to generate approximately 50% more energy than
traditional flat-panel systems while using one-third of the land area, overcoming energy-density and
siting constraints that limit conventional solar. Each tower’s stacked vertical design and
integrated tracking system capture both low-angle morning and evening light, producing a dual-peak
power curve that better aligns with real energy demand.

The Fan Festival installations build on Janta’s growing commercial applications. Pilot programs are
underway with major global airports, including [Munich International
Airport][55], [Aena][56] (operator of over 70 airports worldwide), and [Dallas–Fort Worth
International Airport][57] (DFW), as part of the [Airports for Innovation][58] (A4I) initiative. The
momentum reflects a broader shift already under way: as power-hungry industries from AI to
telecommunications race to secure more capacity, the ability to stand up clean, quiet power sources
on limited square footage is a competitive advantage.

Janta Power | [www.jantaus.com][59]

[ [Factorial Secures First Commercial Aerospace Order for Advanced Battery Cells] ][60]
Jul 24, 2026 [

#### Factorial Secures First Commercial Aerospace Order for Advanced Battery Cells

][61]

**Factorial Energy Inc.** (Nasdaq: FAC) ("Factorial"), a leading American solid-state battery
innovator, announced its first commercial drone battery order. The order marks Factorial’s entry
into commercial aerospace applications.

The order marks Factorial’s first commercial order in the aerospace sector and follows successful
battery integration and drone flight testing. Factorial will supply high-energy-density
lithium-metal cells for integration into battery packs by a U.S.-based pack integrator, creating a
battery cell and pack supply chain designed to support demanding drone applications.

Factorial provides a foundation built to scale across the full breadth of physical AI — drones,
autonomous aviation, space, defense, and robotics — and to power a generation of autonomous machines
that must carry both their own intelligence and their own energy.

Unlike artificial intelligence operating inside centralized data centers, physical AI is embedded in
machines that operate in the real world. Drones, autonomous aircraft, mobile robots, spacecraft,
defense platforms, and other intelligent systems must carry both their own computing capability and
their own energy. These applications require more than batteries that simply store energy: they
require systems that deliver high power, manage heat, operate safely near people and sensitive
electronics, and maintain reliability under demanding environmental and mission conditions.

“We are thrilled about this commercial order from the aerospace sector, on the heels of our
successful integration and drone flight test that demonstrated a more than 30% increase in flight
range,” said Siyu Huang, CEO of Factorial. “It’s a validation that the same rigorous qualification
standards behind last year’s 1,200 km record drive and our first vehicle production program now
extend into an entirely new field. In only six months, we designed a new product, built integration
partnerships on three continents, completed flight testing, and secured a first purchase order. That
is the strategy working as designed. We are committed to building the foundational energy layer that
will underpin the next era of mobility and artificial intelligence. Humanity deserves better
batteries, and delivering them is our mission.”

As batteries become critical infrastructure for autonomous and intelligent systems over the next
decade, Factorial is positioning its technology to serve a broad and rapidly expanding marketplace.
According to a [March 2026 report][62] by the strategy consulting business unit of
PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), the global Physical AI market is projected to reach approximately €430
billion by 2030, with significant upside potential as systems that operate in the real, physical
world continue to scale and mature.

Factorial Energy | [www.factorialenergy.com][63]

platform, reshoring critical advanced manufacturing, strengthening U.S. supply-chain resilience, and

infrastructure.

Jul 24, 2026 [

#### Janta Power Brings Rapidly Deployable Clean Energy to Fan Festivals and Beyond

][54]

**Janta Power**, a leading developer of patented three-dimensional solar tower energy systems,
announced a milestone for rapidly deployable infrastructure in support of one of the world’s largest
sporting events. At Fan Festival sites in Dallas and Houston, Janta’s innovative solar towers
generated power quietly and concurrently, demonstrating a new model for energy installations that
simplify sourcing logistics and align with compressed operational timelines.

[solar]The Dallas installation at Fair Park consists of four JP5K solar towers with integrated 28
kWh battery energy storage systems (BESS) and served as a temporary power source for the duration of
the Fan Festival. The East Downtown Houston tower and associated BESS served the Fan Festival and
will remain as a permanent fixture, purchased to benefit the community and provide power for public
amenities over a 25-year life span.

Both tower systems were deployed and fully operational within days, generating up to 275 KWh per day
to support event infrastructure for thousands of visitors throughout the Fan Festivals. In addition,
the towers feature a small footprint and visually appealing, fully functional body panels with
graphic designs representing the energetic spirit of the host cities.

"The World Cup is more than a sporting event – it's a proving ground for the future of energy
infrastructure," said Mohammed Njie, Founder and CEO of Janta Power. "By providing clean, quiet
power in days instead of months, we're demonstrating that renewable energy can be delivered where
it's needed most, without sacrificing speed, reliability, or performance. Whether it's powering a
global event, an AI data center, an airport, or a community, our mission is the same: to make clean,
affordable, and reliable energy quickly available wherever people need it.”

“Reliable power is a constant logistical consideration across festivals and large-scale events, so
solutions that simplify deployment can have a real operational impact,” said Skye Fabrizio,
Sustainability Manager at C3 Presents. “Janta’s towers were installed quickly, required minimal
space compared to standard solar installations, and provided quiet, reliable power directly on-site.
After seeing the technology in action, I see meaningful potential for its use across a much wider
range of live events and temporary installations."

Janta’s vertical solar towers are designed to generate approximately 50% more energy than
traditional flat-panel systems while using one-third of the land area, overcoming energy-density and
siting constraints that limit conventional solar. Each tower’s stacked vertical design and
integrated tracking system capture both low-angle morning and evening light, producing a dual-peak
power curve that better aligns with real energy demand.

The Fan Festival installations build on Janta’s growing commercial applications. Pilot programs are
underway with major global airports, including [Munich International
Airport][55], [Aena][56] (operator of over 70 airports worldwide), and [Dallas–Fort Worth
International Airport][57] (DFW), as part of the [Airports for Innovation][58] (A4I) initiative. The
momentum reflects a broader shift already under way: as power-hungry industries from AI to
telecommunications race to secure more capacity, the ability to stand up clean, quiet power sources
on limited square footage is a competitive advantage.

Janta Power | [www.jantaus.com][59]

[ [Factorial Secures First Commercial Aerospace Order for Advanced Battery Cells] ][60]
Jul 24, 2026 [

#### Factorial Secures First Commercial Aerospace Order for Advanced Battery Cells

][61]

**Factorial Energy Inc.** (Nasdaq: FAC) ("Factorial"), a leading American solid-state battery
innovator, announced its first commercial drone battery order. The order marks Factorial’s entry
into commercial aerospace applications.

The order marks Factorial’s first commercial order in the aerospace sector and follows successful
battery integration and drone flight testing. Factorial will supply high-energy-density
lithium-metal cells for integration into battery packs by a U.S.-based pack integrator, creating a
battery cell and pack supply chain designed to support demanding drone applications.

Factorial provides a foundation built to scale across the full breadth of physical AI — drones,
autonomous aviation, space, defense, and robotics — and to power a generation of autonomous machines
that must carry both their own intelligence and their own energy.

Unlike artificial intelligence operating inside centralized data centers, physical AI is embedded in
machines that operate in the real world. Drones, autonomous aircraft, mobile robots, spacecraft,
defense platforms, and other intelligent systems must carry both their own computing capability and
their own energy. These applications require more than batteries that simply store energy: they
require systems that deliver high power, manage heat, operate safely near people and sensitive
electronics, and maintain reliability under demanding environmental and mission conditions.

“We are thrilled about this commercial order from the aerospace sector, on the heels of our
successful integration and drone flight test that demonstrated a more than 30% increase in flight
range,” said Siyu Huang, CEO of Factorial. “It’s a validation that the same rigorous qualification
standards behind last year’s 1,200 km record drive and our first vehicle production program now
extend into an entirely new field. In only six months, we designed a new product, built integration
partnerships on three continents, completed flight testing, and secured a first purchase order. That
is the strategy working as designed. We are committed to building the foundational energy layer that
will underpin the next era of mobility and artificial intelligence. Humanity deserves better
batteries, and delivering them is our mission.”

As batteries become critical infrastructure for autonomous and intelligent systems over the next
decade, Factorial is positioning its technology to serve a broad and rapidly expanding marketplace.
According to a [March 2026 report][62] by the strategy consulting business unit of
PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), the global Physical AI market is projected to reach approximately €430
billion by 2030, with significant upside potential as systems that operate in the real, physical
world continue to scale and mature.

# OPG Mobility: India's Leading EV Company

##### About Us

## Welcome to OPG Mobility Private limited Inspiring Every Journey

OPG Mobility Electric Vehicle Company in India builds on over four decades of trust, innovation, and
leadership. As a pioneer in battery technology, we have transformed into a complete electric
mobility provider, offering cutting-edge Two-Wheelers and Three-Wheelers.

[Learn More][39]
[OPG Mobility]
[OPG Mobility]

#### Our Vision

To lead India’s transition to a zero-emission and smart transportation ecosystem. OPG Mobility
Electric Vehicle Company in India aim to deliver innovative, reliable, and safe electric mobility
solutions that enhance urban and rural mobility while significantly reducing carbon footprints, one
vehicle at a time.

[OPG Mobility]
[OPG Mobility]

#### Our Mission

We are committed to offering a diverse range of high-quality electric vehicles, ranging from
two-wheelers to three-wheelers, designed for both personal and commercial use. OPG Mobility is
dedicated to making sustainable mobility mainstream, ensuring every journey is powered by
innovation, technology, performance, and sustainability.

## Why OPG Mobility is the Right Choice for Daily Commuters

[The Only Made in India EV]

##### The Only Made in India EV

That Guarantees Zero Downtime with Our Proprietary Battery Tech.

[Sustainability at Heart]

##### Sustainability at Heart

## Meet Our Family

##### Pankaj Naath, Tripura

I was looking for low speed scooter for dropping my kid school. After seeing my friend's F2B
scooter, I was impressed. While exploring options, Okaya's sleek design caught my eye, despite
considering OLA Electric. Making the final choice was easier thanks to their impressive looks.

##### Suvankar Deb, Tripura, Agartala

Searching for an economical vehicle for my staff, I came across Freedum scooters. Their non-RTO
model, with speed limits, impressed me. It effortlessly carries two people and fits our needs
perfectly.

##### Rajan Khandi, Puri, Odisha

My office is 40 km, total running is 80km. I bought MF 35, It has great performance. Now i am saving
180/- daily. Thanks to Okaya.

##### Arun Singh, Departmental Store Owner, Jaipur

I run a kirana shop, and my home is 3-4 km away. Considering my age and daily commute, I decided to
switch to an electric vehicle and chose the Okaya ClassIQ+. It’s been a fantastic decision! The
scooter charges quickly, gives great mileage, and has been running perfectly since I bought it. I
haven’t faced a single issue so far. It easily carries all the shop supplies every day, and when
it's at home, even my kids can ride it because it doesn’t require a license. My delivery boys also
use it for trips up to 4-5 km, thanks to the removable battery that can be charged anytime. The
range is excellent—around 60-70 km—and it costs me just 10-15 paise per km! My neighbours love it
too, as their bikes cost them a lot in maintenance, whereas this scooter is fuel-efficient,
budget-friendly, and environmentally conscious. It’s been a win-win for me.

##### Kartik Singh, Student, Gurugram

Life was so different during school, but when I started college, I realized how important it was to
reach on time for co-curricular activities and also get back home early if needed. That’s when I
decided to get the Okaya Faast F4. Its mileage is amazing—while my friends are busy refueling their
vehicles, I’m already home comfortably! And just look at the color—black looks so classy. Earlier, I
used to spend ₹1000 on petrol out of my ₹500 monthly pocket money, but now, I easily manage a whole
week in just ₹50-60. Plus, it charges fully in just ₹10-20! I’m super happy with my ‘Jigri’ scooter!

##### Shikha Aggarwal, Journalist Delhi

As a first-time learner and starting my first job, everything felt exciting yet nerve-wracking. I
used to worry about being late, and so did my parents. During college, I traveled a lot on my petrol
scooty, but waiting in long queues at petrol pumps often made me late—it was so hectic! That all
changed when I got my favorite red-colored Faast F4 from Okaya. Now, there are no more cab expenses,
no long queues, and my commute is stress-free. It’s the best decision I’ve made!

## Meet Our Family

##### Pankaj Naath, Tripura

I was looking for low speed scooter for dropping my kid school. After seeing my friend's F2B
scooter, I was impressed. While exploring options, Okaya's sleek design caught my eye, despite
considering OLA Electric. Making the final choice was easier thanks to their impressive looks.

##### Suvankar Deb, Tripura, Agartala

Searching for an economical vehicle for my staff, I came across Freedum scooters. Their non-RTO
model, with speed limits, impressed me. It effortlessly carries two people and fits our needs
perfectly.

##### Rajan Khandi, Puri, Odisha

My office is 40 km, total running is 80km. I bought MF 35, It has great performance. Now i am saving
180/- daily. Thanks to Okaya.

##### Arun Singh, Departmental Store Owner, Jaipur

I run a kirana shop, and my home is 3-4 km away. Considering my age and daily commute, I decided to
switch to an electric vehicle and chose the Okaya ClassIQ+. It’s been a fantastic decision! The
scooter charges quickly, gives great mileage, and has been running perfectly since I bought it. I
haven’t faced a single issue so far. It easily carries all the shop supplies every day, and when
it's at home, even my kids can ride it because it doesn’t require a license. My delivery boys also
use it for trips up to 4-5 km, thanks to the removable battery that can be charged anytime. The
range is excellent—around 60-70 km—and it costs me just 10-15 paise per km! My neighbours love it
too, as their bikes cost them a lot in maintenance, whereas this scooter is fuel-efficient,
budget-friendly, and environmentally conscious. It’s been a win-win for me.

##### Kartik Singh, Student, Gurugram

Life was so different during school, but when I started college, I realized how important it was to
reach on time for co-curricular activities and also get back home early if needed. That’s when I
decided to get the Okaya Faast F4. Its mileage is amazing—while my friends are busy refueling their
vehicles, I’m already home comfortably! And just look at the color—black looks so classy. Earlier, I
used to spend ₹1000 on petrol out of my ₹500 monthly pocket money, but now, I easily manage a whole
week in just ₹50-60. Plus, it charges fully in just ₹10-20! I’m super happy with my ‘Jigri’ scooter!

##### Shikha Aggarwal, Journalist Delhi

As a first-time learner and starting my first job, everything felt exciting yet nerve-wracking. I
used to worry about being late, and so did my parents. During college, I traveled a lot on my petrol
scooty, but waiting in long queues at petrol pumps often made me late—it was so hectic! That all
changed when I got my favorite red-colored Faast F4 from Okaya. Now, there are no more cab expenses,
no long queues, and my commute is stress-free. It’s the best decision I’ve made!

## Частые вопросы

Каковы сроки доставки и от чего они зависят?
Доставка из Южной Кореи до Владивостока занимает от 2 до 3 недель, а из Японии и Китая — от 3 до 4
недель. Сроки зависят от удаленности площадки выкупа от экспортного порта, расписания морских судов,
скорости оплаты инвойса клиентом и загруженности таможенного поста во Владивостоке.
Как считается итоговая стоимость?
Цена авто на аукционе + доставка до РФ + таможенная пошлина + утильсбор + СБКТС + наша фиксированная
комиссия. Никаких скрытых платежей.
Производится ли страховка автомобиля?
Да, все автомобили в обязательном порядке страхуются на полную стоимость на каждом этапе
транспортировки — от выкупа на зарубежной площадке до выдачи во Владивостоке.
Можно ли посмотреть авто до покупки?
Конечно. На площадках зачастую есть схема дефектов автомобиля, в соответствии с требованиями клиента
ориентируемся на состояние авто. Так же наш специалист на месте делает технический осмотр и
исследование кузова с помощью толщиномера, после чего высылает подробный фото-отчет и техническое
заключение.
Кто организует доставку?
Доставку до Владивостока организует наш партнер — международная логистическая компания Феникс Азия.
После растаможки вы можете забрать автомобиль самостоятельно во Владивостоке либо мы организуем
доставку в ваш регион автовозом или железной дорогой. Доставка из Владивостока оплачивается отдельно
и не входит в изначальную стоимость на сайте.
Предоставляется ли техническая гарантия на автомобиль?
Юридически мы выступаем вашим агентом по импорту, поэтому предоставить техническую гарантию на
подержанный автомобиль не можем. Однако японские аукционы и корейские дилеры несут строгую
юридическую ответственность перед законом за достоверность аукционного листа и заявленного состояния
автомобиля, за умышленное сокрытие дефектов или скрученный пробег их лишают лицензий!
Какие авто вы НЕ привозите?
Не возим автомобили старше 2008 года — из-за повышенных таможенных ставок и высоких рисков по
техсостоянию. Также не работаем с авто после серьёзных ДТП и без документов.
Зачем нужна временная прописка в ДВФО при растаможке?
Владивостокская таможня регистрирует ввозимые физическими лицами автомобили без личного присутствия
только при наличии прописки в Дальневосточном федеральном округе. Чтобы вам не пришлось лично лететь
во Владивосток для подачи документов, мы помогаем оформить временную регистрацию в ДВФО через портал
Госуслуги, что позволяет растаможить машину дистанционно и абсолютно законно.
Работаете ли с регионами?
Доставляем во все регионы России — автовозом или индивидуальным транспортом. Стоимость доставки
рассчитывается отдельно для каждого города.

##### Engineer Expertise

#### Your trusted guide on the electrification journey

Our engineering experts help you navigate the complexities of the process, carefully evaluating
industry standards and regulations to make sure your solution meets — or exceeds — your
expectations.

[Learn More][76]

[Engineering Expertise][Engineering Expertise]

##### Vehicle & Equipment Integration

#### Tailored solutions designed to meet your specific applications

Each vehicle project is unique, so we tailor our support to OEM needs, ensuring seamless battery
integration — from software interfaces and bug resolution to mechanical mounting, thermal
management, and safety compliance.

[Learn More][77]

[Vehicle and Equipment Integration][Vehicle and Equipment Integration]

##### Servicing & Training

#### Partnership that extends beyond product delivery

From OEM and dealer training to after-sale servicing and parts, our team is equipped to assist you
in addressing any challenges or needs that may arise to ensure your long-term success.

[Learn More][78]

[Servicing and Training][Servicing and Training]
Benefits

## Innovative design. Built to last.

[Compare Batteries][79]

[angled bottom battery][angled bottom battery]

[Safety icon][Safety icon]

###### Safety

Each battery is designed with advanced active and passive safety features to mitigate risks and
ensure optimal performance on the road.

[Durability icon][Durability icon]

###### Durability

Ballistic-grade enclosures and rigorous in-house testing, including vibration, impact, and crush
tests, ensure our batteries can withstand the most demanding environments.

[Energy Density icon][Energy Density icon]

###### Energy Density

Our designs incorporate top-tier cylindrical cells that charge quickly and provide industry-leading
energy density, enabling long-range travel for high-weight ratings.

[Scalability icon][Scalability icon]

###### Scalability

We design our packs with a scalable, modular platform that can be tailored to various vehicle types,
duty cycles, and energy systems ranging from 40 kWh to over 200 kWh.

## Together We're Building a Clean Energy Future

Rexel Energy Solutions is a niche provider of energy optimization and electrification solutions
focused on lighting, controls, EV charging, battery storage, solar PV and HVAC solutions for ESCOs,
Utility-driven programs and  energy retrofits.  When collaborating with RES, we will provide high
quality energy efficiency solutions from the best manufacturers, while saving you time, improving
performance, and offering the support you need to help you grow and maintain a profitable business.
[ ABOUT us ][48]

## Tailored + Flexible Solutions to Help you Exceed your Goals

Because your needs are unique, we offer customized solutions to handle every stage of an energy
project to ensure it runs as smoothly as possible. With the ability to utilize 600+ Rexel locations
nationwide for offsite material storage, and the logistical flexibility to coordinate onsite
storage, our team has the procedures in place to cater to the needs of any project.  We stage
materials per unique requirements to match delivery schedules, and can also offer onsite
installation support.

About us

## Who we are.

**Since 1914, mobility starts with SEG Automotive: Our company’s history literally began with the
invention of the first starter motors and generators.**

Over a century later, we have become a leading global supplier of powertrain components for the
automotive industry – for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, light electric vehicles and in the
aftermarket.

Our rotating machines power over 300 million vehicles on the road today – while significantly
reducing their CO2 emissions – and our innovations and e-machines drive the transition towards a
sustainable, electrified mobility.

At the heart of this success is our cross-cultural team of around 6,000 employees in 14 countries in
the world’s most important automotive markets.




[ Find out more about our company ][58]

## Our vision.

In the early 20th century, cars actually needed to be started by hand. Ever since making hand
cranking obsolete by inventing the first electric starter motor, we are driven by the same
motivation: to make mobility safe, reliable, and efficient.



Since then, #wearethemotor for our industry – both with our products and our innovations.

Now, to combat climate change, mobility faces its greatest transformation: to become green,
electrified, sustainable. We at SEG Automotive are committed to speeding up this vital change by
leveraging our 100 years of experience in developing and manufacturing e-motors.

We are the motor – for the mobility of today and tomorrow. This is our vision, and our
responsibility.

About us

## Who we are.
