invention of the first starter motors and generators.**

Over a century later, we have become a leading global supplier of powertrain components for the
automotive industry – for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, light electric vehicles and in the
aftermarket.

Our rotating machines power over 300 million vehicles on the road today – while significantly
reducing their CO2 emissions – and our innovations and e-machines drive the transition towards a
sustainable, electrified mobility.

At the heart of this success is our cross-cultural team of around 6,000 employees in 14 countries in
the world’s most important automotive markets.




[ Find out more about our company ][58]

## Our vision.

In the early 20th century, cars actually needed to be started by hand. Ever since making hand
cranking obsolete by inventing the first electric starter motor, we are driven by the same
motivation: to make mobility safe, reliable, and efficient.



Since then, #wearethemotor for our industry – both with our products and our innovations.

Now, to combat climate change, mobility faces its greatest transformation: to become green,
electrified, sustainable. We at SEG Automotive are committed to speeding up this vital change by

Products

## What we do.

We are valued across the globe for our reliable, efficient rotating machines that greatly reduce
emissions. Extreme temperatures, tough road conditions or long periods of use – we have the right
solution for any type of engine and application. Accordingly, virtually all major vehicle
manufacturer rely on our products to power their cars and commercial vehicles.

From product platforms for conventional 12V powertrains and 48V Hybrids to highly customizable
solutions for light electric vehicles and high voltage electrification, we understand the needs of
our customers and enable their success: As a reliable global and local partner with flexible
solutions in development and series production – and as a tier 1 supplier and with OE quality for
the automotive aftermarket.

What sets us apart as a supplier in our industry is our unique combination of competencies and size:
We unite the strength of a global player and a century of experience in developing and manufacturing
e-machines with the agility of a mid-sized company.

For our customers that means we are able to produce millions of parts with a fast time-to-market,
competitive prices, and uniform global quality standards in any world region.




[ view our broad product portfolio ][60]
Career

## Working at SEG Automotive.

Mobility and the automotive industry are changing, and our cross-cultural team is at the heart of
that transformation. This, coupled with short decision paths and an empowering culture, gives our
employees the opportunity to truly make an impact and [ build their career][61] while co-creating
the future of mobility.

From engineering e-machines or the corresponding software, securing our quality, global supply chain
or IT infrastructure to working with our customers or developing our people: No matter where your
strengths lie, we can offer you a fulfilling, challenging job that contributes to society – paired
with a competitive salary and ample room for personal and international growth.

Join us now and become a motor for the mobility of today and tomorrow!

Over a century later, we have become a leading global supplier of powertrain components for the

aftermarket.

reducing their CO2 emissions – and our innovations and e-machines drive the transition towards a
sustainable, electrified mobility.

the world’s most important automotive markets.

We are the motor – for the mobility of today and tomorrow. This is our vision, and our
responsibility.

About us

## Who we are.

**Since 1914, mobility starts with SEG Automotive: Our company’s history literally began with the
invention of the first starter motors and generators.**

Over a century later, we have become a leading global supplier of powertrain components for the
automotive industry – for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, light electric vehicles and in the
aftermarket.

Our rotating machines power over 300 million vehicles on the road today – while significantly
reducing their CO2 emissions – and our innovations and e-machines drive the transition towards a
sustainable, electrified mobility.

At the heart of this success is our cross-cultural team of around 6,000 employees in 14 countries in
the world’s most important automotive markets.




[ Find out more about our company ][58]

## Our vision.

In the early 20th century, cars actually needed to be started by hand. Ever since making hand
cranking obsolete by inventing the first electric starter motor, we are driven by the same
motivation: to make mobility safe, reliable, and efficient.



Since then, #wearethemotor for our industry – both with our products and our innovations.

Now, to combat climate change, mobility faces its greatest transformation: to become green,
electrified, sustainable. We at SEG Automotive are committed to speeding up this vital change by
leveraging our 100 years of experience in developing and manufacturing e-motors.

We are the motor – for the mobility of today and tomorrow. This is our vision, and our
responsibility.

[ [Opens in a new tab]
[Play button to open a video]
][59]
Products

## What we do.

We are valued across the globe for our reliable, efficient rotating machines that greatly reduce
emissions. Extreme temperatures, tough road conditions or long periods of use – we have the right
solution for any type of engine and application. Accordingly, virtually all major vehicle
manufacturer rely on our products to power their cars and commercial vehicles.

From product platforms for conventional 12V powertrains and 48V Hybrids to highly customizable
solutions for light electric vehicles and high voltage electrification, we understand the needs of
our customers and enable their success: As a reliable global and local partner with flexible
solutions in development and series production – and as a tier 1 supplier and with OE quality for
the automotive aftermarket.

What sets us apart as a supplier in our industry is our unique combination of competencies and size:
We unite the strength of a global player and a century of experience in developing and manufacturing
e-machines with the agility of a mid-sized company.

For our customers that means we are able to produce millions of parts with a fast time-to-market,
competitive prices, and uniform global quality standards in any world region.




[ view our broad product portfolio ][60]
Career

## Working at SEG Automotive.

Mobility and the automotive industry are changing, and our cross-cultural team is at the heart of
that transformation. This, coupled with short decision paths and an empowering culture, gives our
employees the opportunity to truly make an impact and [ build their career][61] while co-creating
the future of mobility.

From engineering e-machines or the corresponding software, securing our quality, global supply chain
or IT infrastructure to working with our customers or developing our people: No matter where your
strengths lie, we can offer you a fulfilling, challenging job that contributes to society – paired
with a competitive salary and ample room for personal and international growth.

Join us now and become a motor for the mobility of today and tomorrow!




[ See Job Opportunities ][62]
Contact

## Contact us.

We are glad to help.

Need more information about our products? Have a question regarding a current job opening? Want to
get in touch with our press office? Or have any other question about SEG Automotive?

## Your power can change the world.

With clean electricity provided by Silicon Valley Clean Energy you have the power to make
all-electric choices that help fight climate change and build a cleaner, greener Silicon Valley for
everyone.

[Landscape photo of rolling hills with windmills]

## Congrats, you are already receiving clean electricity.

By living in our community or having a business here, you get clean electricity automatically from
Silicon Valley Clean Energy.

If you live in one of the communities served by SV Clean Energy [info][55] and did not opt-out, you
are already receiving clean electricity at competitive rates. As a customer, you benefit from
on-bill savings, local control and rebates for home upgrades that help fight climate change in our
community.

### **From Source to Switch – How Your Electricity Service Works**

[source]

## SVCE

It starts with electricity generated from clean sources, built and purchased by SV Clean Energy

[delivery]

## PG&E

This electricity is then delivered by PG&E over the poles and wires they continue to own and
maintain

[customer]

## YOU

Electricity then flows to homes and businesses in the community, benefitting you with cleaner energy
& local control

Silicon Valley Clean Energy (SVCE) is a public, not-for-profit agency that provides clean
electricity for 280,000 residential and business customers across 13 Silicon Valley communities.
SVCE generates clean electricity for you to use in your home or business and PG&E delivers it on
their existing power lines. You get one combined energy bill each month from PG&E but because your
electricity is generated by Silicon Valley Clean Energy and delivered by PG&E you can see these
pieces of your energy are split on the bill for both SVCE and PG&E.

[UNDERSTAND YOUR ENERGY BILL SAVINGS ][56]

## Go Electric for a healthier home and cleaner future

[eHub][57] simplifies your upgrade to all-electric living. Find personalized rebates, incentives,
and tips to power your home, car, and appliances with clean energy.

[Two people posing and smiling in a sleek, electric kitchen]

#### Homeowners

Upgrade your home with electric appliances for comfort, efficiency, and health—claim up to $8,750 in
rebates.

[Find Incentives →][58]

[Asia,People,Young,Family,Man,Woman,Smile,Happy,Sit,At]

#### Renters

Enhance your space with electric appliances for better comfort, efficiency, and a healthier
environment.

[Find Incentives →][59]

[ESA Images full size-28]

#### Future EV Drivers

Discover EVs and your eligibility for over $10,000 in savings from local incentives and federal tax
credits.

[Find Incentives →][60]

[ESA Images full size-59]

#### Businesses

Take advantage of rebates for your business or property, along with installation incentives for
contractors.

[Find Incentives →][61]

## How do I re-enroll?

If you did not opt out and live in one of the 13 communities we serve, no need to re-enroll. You are
already receiving clean electricity!

SVCE is the official electricity provider for the communities of Campbell, Cupertino, Gilroy, Los
Altos, Los Altos Hills, Los Gatos, Milpitas, Monte Sereno, Morgan Hill, Mountain View, Saratoga,
Sunnyvale and Unincorporated Santa Clara County.

If you opted out and would like to re-enroll, call us at [1-844-474-SVCE (7823)][62] or email us at
[customerservice@svcleanenergy.org][63].


## Your Energy Makes an Impact

[competition]

## 96%
## Participation

[graph down]

## 15%
## Reduction

In annual greenhouse gas emissions compared 2015

[cashout-130x146 (1)-01]

an average of seasonal rates. PG&E renewable energy content as reported in the Annual Report to the

renewable energy sources, though hydroelectric power is classified as 100% carbon-free.

加州公用事業委員會不將大型水力發電廠歸類為可再生能源，因為這些發電設施需要建造大壩。

×

En función del uso residencial típico de 491 kWh según el esquema de tarifas E-TOUC con las tarifas
de PG&E actuales y las tarifas de SVCE con entrada en vigencia en enero de 2023. Los costos actuales
variarán según el uso, el lugar, el esquema de tarifas y otros factores. El cálculo proporcionado es
un promedio de tarifas estacionales. Contenido de energía renovable de PG&E según se comunica en el

California en junio de 2022.

×

En función del uso comercial pequeño típico de 1,851 kWh por mes según el esquema de tarifas de
Tiempo de Uso B-1 con las tarifas de PG&E actuales y las tarifas de SVCE con entrada en vigencia en
enero de 2023. Los costos actuales variarán según el uso, el lugar, el esquema de tarifas y otros
factores. El cálculo proporcionado es un promedio de tarifas estacionales. Contenido de energía
renovable de PG&E según se comunica en el Informe Anual al Programa de Divulgación de Fuentes de
Energía de la Comisión de Energía de California en junio de 2022.

×

En función del uso mensual comercial grande de 148,625 kWh por mes y la demanda pico anual de 499 kW
según el esquema de tarifas B19S con las tarifas de PG&E actuales y las tarifas de SVCE con entrada
en vigencia en enero de 2023. Los costos actuales variarán según el uso, el lugar, el esquema de
tarifas y otros factores. El cálculo proporcionado es un promedio de tarifas estacionales. Contenido
de energía renovable de PG&E según se comunica en el Informe Anual al Programa de Divulgación de
Fuentes de Energía de la Comisión de Energía de California en junio de 2022.

×

La Comisión de Servicios Públicos de California no clasifica las grandes instalaciones
hidroeléctricas como fuentes de energía renovable, aunque están clasificadas como 100 % libres de
carbono.

×

 

Dựa theo mức sử dụng tư gia điển hình là 491 kWh theo biểu giá E-TOUC ở mức giá hiện tại của PG&E,
và mức giá của SVCE có hiệu lực từ tháng Giêng, 2023. Chi phí thực sự sẽ thay đổi tùy theo mức sử
dụng, địa điểm, biểu giá và những yếu tố khác.

## Your power can change the world.

With clean electricity provided by Silicon Valley Clean Energy you have the power to make
all-electric choices that help fight climate change and build a cleaner, greener Silicon Valley for
everyone.

[Landscape photo of rolling hills with windmills]

## Congrats, you are already receiving clean electricity.

By living in our community or having a business here, you get clean electricity automatically from
Silicon Valley Clean Energy.

If you live in one of the communities served by SV Clean Energy [info][55] and did not opt-out, you
are already receiving clean electricity at competitive rates. As a customer, you benefit from
on-bill savings, local control and rebates for home upgrades that help fight climate change in our
community.

### **From Source to Switch – How Your Electricity Service Works**

[source]

## SVCE

It starts with electricity generated from clean sources, built and purchased by SV Clean Energy

[delivery]

## PG&E

This electricity is then delivered by PG&E over the poles and wires they continue to own and
maintain

[customer]

## YOU

Electricity then flows to homes and businesses in the community, benefitting you with cleaner energy
& local control

Silicon Valley Clean Energy (SVCE) is a public, not-for-profit agency that provides clean
electricity for 280,000 residential and business customers across 13 Silicon Valley communities.
SVCE generates clean electricity for you to use in your home or business and PG&E delivers it on
their existing power lines. You get one combined energy bill each month from PG&E but because your
electricity is generated by Silicon Valley Clean Energy and delivered by PG&E you can see these
pieces of your energy are split on the bill for both SVCE and PG&E.

[UNDERSTAND YOUR ENERGY BILL SAVINGS ][56]

[eHub][57] simplifies your upgrade to all-electric living. Find personalized rebates, incentives,
and tips to power your home, car, and appliances with clean energy.

If you did not opt out and live in one of the 13 communities we serve, no need to re-enroll. You are
already receiving clean electricity!

SVCE is the official electricity provider for the communities of Campbell, Cupertino, Gilroy, Los
Altos, Los Altos Hills, Los Gatos, Milpitas, Monte Sereno, Morgan Hill, Mountain View, Saratoga,
Sunnyvale and Unincorporated Santa Clara County.
